title: Lomekwi 3 stone tools, Kenya
summary: Researchers reported stone tools from Lomekwi 3, near the western shore of Lake Turkana in northern Kenya, dated to 3.3 million years ago. That is about 700,000 years earlier than Oldowan tools. The tools are much larger than later Oldowan ones, and the sources say it is not known which hominin made them.

uncertainty.note: Years before present in the sources are written here as negative calendar years without subtracting 1950; the sources give rounded ages. Both sources give 3.3 million years without an error range.

where.historical_name: Western shore of Lake Turkana, in what is now northern Kenya; no polity applies

importance.justification: Reported as the oldest stone tools on record at the time, predating Oldowan artifacts by 700,000 years.
